keys.key: src/seeds/contacts.seed.ts:66-70 · seedContacts · the idempotency check uses deletedAt: { $exists: false }, which misses contacts that carry an explicit deletedAt: null (imported ones), so a re-run creates duplicates
src/seeds/pro-microsites.seed.ts:63-89 · seedProMicrosites · the slug-taken skip is gone, so a slug held by another account makes create() throw a duplicate-key error and aborts the whole seed run
src/modules/contacts/contacts.repo.ts:50 · listPaginated · a whitespace-only search passes the truthiness check, the word list filters to empty, and an empty $and makes MongoDB reject the query

src/seeds/journey-invitations.seed.ts:87 · seedJourneyInvitations · journeys are listed across all owners (first 100) instead of the consumer's, so the invitation can attach to another owner's journey with the same template key

findings.effect: The journey lookup searches platform-wide without scoping to the owner and reads only the first 100 journeys, so it can miss home-seller-v1 and skip the invitation without an error. It can also pick another consumer's journey of that template.
findings.quote:
const { items: journeys } = await journeysService.listPaginated({ page: 1, limit: 100 })
const journey = journeys.find((item) => item.templateKey === invitation.journeyTemplateKey)
findings.reason: It names the seeded file, locates the lookup at line 88, and describes selecting another owner's journey.

findings.effect: The sender's consumer profile is looked up but only used to skip the invitation when it is missing. This makes the professional invitation depend on Ricardo also having an unrelated consumer profile.
findings.reason: The consumer-profile lookup genuinely blocks professional invitations when that unused profile is absent, but this is a separate defect from S4.

findings.effect: The unused consumer-profile check skips the only invitation with just a warning if Ricardo has no consumer profile, even though the invitation is sent by the professional actor.
findings.reason: The check unnecessarily skips the professional invitation without a consumer profile, but it does not describe S4's incorrect journey selection.

findings.effect: The journey is picked by template key from only the first page of 100 journeys. If another home-seller-v1 journey is seeded, or the list passes 100 journeys, the invitation will silently go to the wrong journey or be skipped.
findings.reason: Despite the incorrect line number, it quotes the seeded lookup and describes selecting the wrong journey from the unscoped first page.
